-- ==============================================================================
-- KODE BACKEND SUPABASE (SQL SCRIPT)
-- Salin semua kode di bawah ini, lalu jalankan di menu "SQL Editor" di Supabase
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. Membuat Tabel BankSoal
CREATE TABLE public."BankSoal" (
  "id" bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "No" integer,
  "Soal" text,
  "URL Gambar Soal" text,
  "Opsi A" text,
  "Gambar Opsi A" text,
  "Opsi B" text,
  "Gambar Opsi B" text,
  "Opsi C" text,
  "Gambar Opsi C" text,
  "Opsi D" text,
  "Gambar Opsi D" text,
  "Kunci Jawaban" text
);

-- 2. Membuat Tabel DataNilai
CREATE TABLE public."DataNilai" (
  "id" bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "Waktu Submit" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT timezone('utc'::text, now()),
  "Nama Siswa" text,
  "Kelas" text,
  "Skor Benar" integer,
  "Total Soal" integer,
  "Nilai Akhir (100)" numeric,
  "Status Kecurangan" text,
  "Detail Jawaban" text
);

-- 3. Membuat Tabel PengaturanUjian
CREATE TABLE public."PengaturanUjian" (
  "id" bigint PRIMARY KEY,
  "Jenis Ujian" text,
  "Tahun Pelajaran" text,
  "Nama Sekolah" text,
  "Alamat Sekolah" text,
  "Logo URL" text,
  "Nama Kepala Sekolah" text,
  "NIP Kepala Sekolah" text,
  "Token" text,
  "Tanggal Ujian" text,
  "Durasi" integer
);

-- 4. Membuat Tabel AdminAuth (Admin Biasa)
CREATE TABLE public."AdminAuth" (
  "id" bigint PRIMARY KEY,
  "Username" text,
  "Password" text
);

-- 5. Membuat Tabel SuperAdminAuth (Master Admin)
CREATE TABLE public."SuperAdminAuth" (
  "id" bigint PRIMARY KEY,
  "Username" text,
  "Password" text
);

-- ==============================================================================
-- MENONAKTIFKAN ROW LEVEL SECURITY (RLS)
-- (Penting agar frontend HTML statis bisa membaca/menulis database tanpa login OAuth)
-- ==============================================================================
ALTER TABLE public."BankSoal" DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public."DataNilai" DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public."PengaturanUjian" DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public."AdminAuth" DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public."SuperAdminAuth" DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
